name: Clinical Clarity
rationale: Swiss-style grid with a single deep green accent; dense, factual hierarchy for the lab director who wants specifications fast.

name: Daylight
rationale: The company name taken literally: warm daylight gradients and amber highlights over white, airy and optimistic without losing clinical credibility.

name: Field Notes
rationale: Photography-led and human-scale on an earthy off-white; full-bleed field imagery frames the science for the public-health audience.

name: Data Sheet
rationale: A beautifully typeset technical datasheet: monospace numerals, ruled tables and specification blocks that treat the assay like the instrument it is.

name: Editorial
rationale: Magazine editorial: serif display, asymmetric columns and pull-quotes that let the eight differentiators read like reported facts.

name: Card Deck
rationale: The blood-spot card is the interface: every component is a rounded, tactile card, modular like a kit laid out on a bench.

name: Precision Instrument
rationale: Hairline rules, fine engineering type and cool greys with green; the restraint of a calibrated laboratory instrument.

name: Bold Public Health
rationale: Poster-scale type and solid green blocks on white; built to be read on a district health officer's phone in sunlight.

name: Minimal
rationale: Radical restraint: one typeface, one accent, no decoration; the content carries everything through spacing and rhythm.

name: Diagram-First
rationale: Every section anchored by an explanatory SVG diagram — workflow, assay, throughput — the site as an illustrated explainer.

name: Warm Institutional
rationale: Muted green and gold with serif headings and prominent credentials; the settled confidence of an established research institute.

name: Motion & Depth
rationale: Layered light surfaces, soft shadows and gentle lift on scroll; a modern SaaS feel that stays bright and clinical.

name: Enterprise Trust
rationale: Agent-directed via ui-ux-pro-max ('molecular diagnostics B2B' → Trust & Authority system): navy-and-sky enterprise palette, Lexend headings, and a credential proof bar directly after the hero — certifications before product, the order a lab director actually evaluates in.

name: Soft Clinic
rationale: Agent-directed via ui-ux-pro-max ('medical device manufacturer' → Neumorphism, tempered for AA): a calm cyan monochrome ground with softly embossed surfaces and pill controls — the tactile, instrument-like calm of a well-made medical device, with text contrast kept clinical.

name: Glasshouse
rationale: Agent-directed via ui-ux-pro-max ('biotech genomics research platform' → light Glassmorphism + scroll-storytelling): frosted panels over soft sky-and-green colour fields, Exo headings with mono chapter annotations, the page read as a numbered narrative — fully legible with scrolling effects off.

name: Operations Console
rationale: Agent-directed via ui-ux-pro-max ('field operations logistics at scale' → Real-Time/Operations landing): a screening operation rendered as a working console — metrics band straight after the hero, mono status chips, the 24-hour protocol as a tracked timeline — in a tracking-blue and delivery-orange utility palette.
